notes.title: New Free Update!
notes.content:
We are pleased to release a new update with community-driven ideas!

Update:
[list]
[*] New World ' Desert'
[*] New Hidden World to Unlock
[*] New Puzzle system in free-fly to unlock items and worlds

[/list]
Other Updates:
[list]
[*] New skydive system, you will now fall at 90 degrees and can pull out of the dive with the glide button for a boost.
[*] Reimagined Dragon Valley - with new rides and new places to find - can you find the 14 Statues?

[/list]

Please let us know what you think! and please review the game if you have not already!

notes.title: New Free World Update!
notes.content:
We are pleased to provide a free update!

[u]New Re-imagined Canyons World.[/u]
[list]
[*] This 16KMx16KM world has lots to discover, from hidden caves to waterfalls and new rides!
[*] Try Egg Hunt and watch out for those crossbows!
[*] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/492b7fcd3c65ba7aa85b935fdf622d541428ff85.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/b696ccf8238e4eb4bc3252876e9ccf28772b2da5.jpg[/img][/url]
[/list]

[u]New Dragon's to Ride[/u]
[list]
[*] You can ride new Dragons as well as and the previous Wyverns in this new update.
[*] Go to 'Smooth Ride' in Dragon Valley and Volcano Island for the new Dragon. These also move up and down less  - so good for first-time flyers!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/fb336a36964b95b8fc9c4ac8f1617b1d11cc6cc7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/b07aca31a3b8cf9a67c3376eb947fbf53539106a.png[/img][/url]
[/list]

[u]New Easter Eggs to Discover! [/u]
We are always adding new little things in the game you can find and some of them have Epic consequences! - Look for them.

[u]Optimizations and other additions[/u]
[list]
[*] Freefly - Sprint is now a Toggle (No need to hold it down to sprint)
[*] New wet skin system
[*] New Updated Red Dragon Skin 
[*] New Riding saddle (Multiple Colors)
[*] Fixed Controls UI to more obvious you can change your controls system.
[*] Optimized Cartoon Mountain
[*] Optimized New Canyon Map (30% less processing needed)
[/list]

Thanks again to you the community for the ideas and feedback!

PLEASE REVIEW THE GAME if you have not already! We are so close to being over 90% positive !! 

Check us out on Twitch and Discord!

notes.title: DragonRideVR V3 Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/8aa0448906f16fb5f6e08e1d86d3856bb9cd06b8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/c3556fc54068d7fa2acdb6ee50640177bbc245ab.png[/img]
[b]RhythmRide -[/b] Experience breathtaking worlds swinging your swords to the musical beats. Pop the balloons and break the targets as you fly towards them on the back of the dragon! Match up the color and direction to get maximum points! 

[list]
[*] 25 Handcrafted songs each with 5 difficulty levels.
[*] 5 Genres of Music to choose from
[*] Global Leaderboards
[*] 5 Ride Types from smooth straight to more challenging Wild!
[*] Easy to play and a great workout.
[*] Progress and unlock custom options.
[*] Modifiers to support the novice player up to the competitive player level.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/6ea74d6da0fab88e5fe627855da5b94273da45f8.png[/img]
New: Spectator Cam - Perfect for [b] Live Streaming [/b]yourself playing the game or making awesome videos.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/af7bbe23f8db669889bcd67c0af2e578a5008503.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/59c2b266b117ce169d6f5696b660845acd901772.png[/img][/url]

New Features:
[list]
[*] RythmRide
[*] Dragon Customization
[*] Sword Customization
[*] Helmet Customization 
[*] More Performance options to fine-tune and get the most out of your PC ( Including the ability to turn OFF the second screen)
[*] Updated Dragon Valley World
[/list]

2 New Worlds:
[list]
[*] Tropical Islands[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/dc65b9a741c4df8244736e6ff59f73427fca89c5.jpg[/img]
[*]Cartoon Mountain[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/66507f0598edfe46e6479bd50c56620a6f6fad04.png[/img]
[/list]

Updates:
[list]
[*] Smoother dragon animation on Rides
[*] Leaderboards for Target Games
[*] New Cleaner UI 
[*] Minor Fixes
[/list]

Much of this is based on community ideas and feedback, thank you so much for your support.!

As always if you find a bug or issue, let us know and we will fix it and get a patch out ASAP.

TypeEh Studios.

notes.title: MAJOR RELEASE
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/e3fedebd93f62290413c23f96358161bfa57b30c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/b818a57781752aa6f2e8d9ab91ddad38b3ddac09.png[/img][/url]
The most requested feature for DragonRideVR is now out - [u][b]FreeFly[/b][/u]

[b][u]FreeFly[/u][/b] - You can control your own dragon using the motion controllers or a [b]gamepad[/b]:

[u]New Features in FreeFly:[/u]
[list]
[*]  Walk / Run / Jump / Swim / Fly / Glide Modes
[*]  Fireball 
[*]  Smash / Attack
[*]  Control Customization (see in-game menu)
[*]  Dragon Customization (unlocks)
[*]  New Views - Be the dragon / Ride the Dragon / Outside the Dragon
[*]  Giant Crossbows that can attack
[*] New Destructible Items: Crates / Doors / Targets / Giant Defence CrossBows
(See [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2272859659]FreeFly Guide[/url])
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/c649532ea1342cc3f20cc4c92156b285324ea99a.png[/img]

[b][u]New FreeFly Game Modes:[/u][/b]
[b]FreeFly[/b] - No Time limit just explore - Collect Crystals / Fly through rings.
[b]BallonHunt [/b]- Fly into or Shoot balloons to get the highest score before time runs out.
[b]EggHunt [/b]- 15 progressive Levels - Find The missing Eggs and unlock customizations, avoid being shot down!

 
[u][b]2 New Worlds:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Ice Worlds - Frozen Land
[*] Canyons - 16KM Map
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/f03bf314da1c18d40ddbcd046b76a37e72670afd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/c14693d652bfc57c8492db27514ecde95b5e212a.png[/img][/url]


[u][b]Other Updates:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Improved seat position on rides
[*] Dynamic Shadow and VR performance settings
[*] Update to Dragon Valley Map
[*] FreeFly LeaderBoards
[*] FreeFly Achievements
[*] 15 more music tracks to choose from in FreeFly
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/46011d3bdddd69626710262ab8db25a86b3d98d3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36464877/59f2178efddbca521f65a258c761cf1b8b5199fd.png[/img][/url]
More Updates to come:
[list]
[*] Leaderboards for Ride Games
[*] New Giant Cave world
[/list]

Thanks to all the Beta Tester!

Regards
TypeEhStudios

notes.title: New Version 1.6 Available
notes.content:
[u]Update:[/u]

[list]
[*] New Lightning Spell - Powerful spell that instantly destroys targets and balloons and Catapulted Fireballs!
[*] More Spells Faster - Earn powerups more often (now every 15,000 points)
[*] Dual CrossBows all the Time
[*] New Swimming animation so that immersion is better (Saddle doesn't move under you)
[*] FlashLights more powerful in the crystal cave level 
[*] Underwater Glitch Fixed for Index Users
[*] Optimizations and bug fixes
[*] Support for HTC COSMOS
[*] New Epic Engine that improves load times and performance.
[/list]

Save options are now stored under AppData/Local/DragonRideVR/Saved/SaveGames and will not move going forward.  

If you wish to [b]keep your old high scores and preferences[/b] (from v 1.5) do a one time copy from your steamspps/common/DragonRiderVR/Saved/SaveGames to the new location and restart the game (We cannot automate this - sorry)

Thanks for the feedback that helps us improve the game, look for further updates soon.
TypeEhStudios
